description:
NEW FILE: apps/octo_pi_coder/lib/octo_pi/coder/extension/macro.ex (or inline into behaviour.ex)

Implement the 'use OctoPi.Coder.Extension' macro.

WHAT THE MACRO DOES:
1. Injects '@behaviour OctoPi.Coder.Extension.Behaviour' into the using module.
2. Registers a '__before_compile__' hook.
3. In __before_compile__/1: scan the module for exported handle_* functions using Module.definitions_in(env.module, :def). For each matching name + arity, record it.
4. Generate a def init(api) function body that:
   a. If mount/0 is exported: call __MODULE__.mount(), pattern-match {:ok, initial_state}, call Agent.start_link(fn -> initial_state end) to get state_agent pid.
   b. For each 2-arity handle_<event_type>/2 found: emit API.on(api, :<event_type>, fn event, ctx -> __MODULE__.handle_<event_type>(event, ctx) end).
   c. For each 3-arity handle_<event_type>/3 found: emit API.on(api, :<event_type>, fn event, ctx -> state = Agent.get(state_agent, & &1); {result, new_state} = __MODULE__.handle_<event_type>(event, ctx, state); Agent.update(state_agent, fn _ -> new_state end); result end). This closure closes over state_agent.
   d. Return {:ok, api}.
5. If mount/0 is exported: also generate 'def __state_agent__, do: <state_agent_pid>' for test introspection. This is intentionally not part of the public extension API.

AGENT LIFECYCLE: The Agent created in step 4a lives until explicitly stopped. build_extension/2 in API must carry state_agent pid on Extension.t() so Extension.Manager can stop it on session end. Add state_agent: pid() | nil field to Extension.t() struct. Set it in API.build_extension/2 if the api has a state_agent recorded. The macro must store the Agent pid on the API struct during init/1 -- add a state_agent field to API.t() for this purpose.

OWNERSHIP: Extension.Manager (introduced in opi-fin.3.1) owns Agent lifecycle. It loads extensions, collects state_agent pids from the returned Extension.t() structs, and stops them all in its terminate/2. The Session.Runner does NOT stop Agents directly -- it delegates to Extension.Manager.

BACKWARDS COMPATIBILITY: Extensions NOT using 'use OctoPi.Coder.Extension' continue to work identically. The macro is purely additive.

Requires: opi-fin.2.1 (Extension.Behaviour) to be merged first.

TEST: New test file macro_test.exs. Test: (1) a stateless extension using the macro auto-registers its handle_* fn; (2) a stateful extension using mount/0 gets state threaded correctly across two handler calls; (3) __state_agent__/0 returns a pid; (4) state updates from one handler are visible to the next handler call.
title: Implement use OctoPi.Coder.Extension macro
